translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with Phase 1.

'document chasing' -> 'persecución de documentos' / 'perseguir documentos'. 'onboarding' -> 'incorporación'. 'engagement letter' -> 'hoja de encargo'. 'month end close' -> 'cierre de mes'. 'ledger' -> 'libro contable'. 'draft entries' -> 'asientos en borrador'. 'chart of accounts' -> 'plan de cuentas'. 'reconciliation' -> 'conciliación'. 'bookkeeper'/'accountant' -> 'contable'; 'bookkeeping firm' -> 'firma de teneduría de libros'.
'fee questions' -> 'preguntas de honorarios'; 'filing deadline' -> 'plazo de presentación'; 'tax season' -> 'temporada de impuestos'; 'return' (tax return) -> 'declaración'.
'QuickBooks', 'Xero' kept (product names). Other brands (n8n, Make, Zapier, Google Workspace, Slack, Calendly) unchanged.
Stat chip with data-prefix 'under ' -> 'menos de ' and suffix ' sec' -> ' seg'; '20+ hrs' -> '20+ h'; '24/7' unchanged.
Prices/figures unchanged, currency named: '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; '$50 to $300' -> '50 a 300 dólares'.
Case study reuses the real-estate brokerage story deliberately (the source does too) to show the same follow-up mechanics; kept faithful.
Blog 'related reading' links point to English blog posts (Phase 3 not started); anchor text translated. Nav/footer service + industry links point to /es.
